title: festuca gracillima var. monticola
intro: Festuca gracillima var. monticola, commonly known as mountain fescue, is a perennial grass species belonging to the Poaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and stress due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of mountain fescue include sedation, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of Festuca gracillima var. monticola include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
